extracted.intended_audience: patent searchers, IP professionals, librarians and DWPI/Clarivate users
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and standards for using the Derwent World Patents Index (DWPI) product: what data it contains, how records are edited and structured (patent families), searchable fields and field codes, classification and chemical indexing, search tools/options, and available output formats.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope and coverage (records and volume)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides access to information for over 37.4 million inventions covering more than 100 million patent documents worldwide; each update adds an average of 46,000 documents from more than 50 worldwide sources including patent-issuing authorities and defensive publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Useful for users interested in technical content, business planning, development, or protecting innovations. See Sources page for full supplier list.

rubrics_metrics.name: Document unit: patent family as single document
rubrics_metrics.description: Each DWPISM document represents a single invention or 'patent family' (the first publication, or 'basic patent', plus later published patents relating to that invention, known as 'equivalents').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Records include both Derwent family-level data and original publication data for each family member.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editorial quality control
rubrics_metrics.description: DWPISM documents go through an extensive editorial process: raw data is reviewed and corrected for mistakes and missing information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: On average DWPI editors identify and correct 800–1,000 priority errors per week from raw patent data records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derwent written titles and abstracts purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: Derwent written titles and abstracts are written to summarize the novelty, use and advantage of an invention.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Derwent abstracts are in English and are provided at the patent family level alongside original data for family members.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derwent abstract structure and components
rubrics_metrics.description: The Derwent written abstract is organized into paragraphs with informative, searchable paragraph headings and contains a Novelty paragraph describing the non-obvious improvements over previous technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Also includes Technology Focus paragraphs (different technological viewpoints), Extension Abstract and Documentation to bridge concise abstract and full text patent document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Original publication (as-published) data inclusion and variability
rubrics_metrics.description: Original publication data includes full author name and address, document title, abstract, claims, patent classification codes, filing details, and legal representative.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The amount of original publication data present in each record varies by publishing authority, patent kind, and time; Sources section indicates variation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Derwent indexing: classes, manual codes, and chemical/polymer indexing
rubrics_metrics.description: Derwent provides proprietary Derwent Classes and Derwent Manual Codes, subject indexing and in-depth chemical and polymer indexing, electrical and engineering drawings (from 1988) and chemical structure drawings (from 1992).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indexes facilitate searching by technology, chemical fragments, Markush, DCR numbers, PLASDOC/polymer codes and other domain-specific codes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subject and date coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Subject coverage: pharmaceutical patents from 1963, agricultural from 1965, polymer/plastics from 1966, chemical from 1970, all patentable technologies from 1974; Date coverage: 1963 - present.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Some older records (pre-1970) may lack certain fields such as abstracts or full bibliographic detail.

rubrics_metrics.name: Geographic and update coverage
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic coverage: International; Update Frequency: 82 updates/year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Sources list contains detailed supplier and country coverage information (downloadable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Document type and publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: The only document type in DWPI is 'patent'. DWPI is provided by Clarivate Analytics (publisher contact via ProQuest Dialog support).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact Customer Care or ProQuest Dialog Global Customer Support for content questions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — bibliographic/patent identification fields
rubrics_metrics.description: Many bibliographic fields are searchable via field codes (e.g., AN accession number, PN/PNA publication numbers, APN/APNA application numbers, APC/APD application country/date, PA patent assignee, INV inventor).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Field codes accept various number formats (examples provided). Use PNUM/APN variants; some fields support multiple forms (basic, equivalent, related). See sample queries for syntax.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — dates and numeric fields behavior
rubrics_metrics.description: Date fields (PD, PDA, APD etc.) support searching by full date, month or year (pd(20041014), pd(200410), pd(2004)). Numeric and non-numeric fields have different behaviors (NR numeric, NCP/NCBP non-numeric).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Numeric fields (e.g. NCN, NPF) allow comparison operators like > and <; non-numeric fields do not accept comparison symbols.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — language, legal representative, and counts
rubrics_metrics.description: Fields include LA (original publication language), LRP/LRL (legal representative name/address), NR/NCN/NPF counts for references, cited patents, citing patents and patent family size.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Language may be missing if the document is in the primary language of the patent country; some historical coding limits exist (see notes).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — classifications and attributes
rubrics_metrics.description: Classification fields include CPC, ECLA, IPC, JPC, JPF, USCL, DC and Derwent Class codes; IPC/CPC versions and attributes are important (IPC Version 7 before 2006, Version 8 from 2006; CPC available from March 2013).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For comprehensive retrieval, search both older and reformed IPC forms; CPC/IPC attributes include classification level, value (I/A), position, status, version date, action date, source and assigning office.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — patent text (abstract, claims, title, document text)
rubrics_metrics.description: Text fields include AB (abstract), AAB (alerting abstract), DAB (documentation/extended abstract), CLM (claims), TI (title), TX (all fields + text), and others.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Claims are the legal text describing the patent. Use field codes to target specific text fields; e.g., TI searches both Derwent and original titles. About 88% of records have Alerting abstracts; some pre-1970 or certain countries may not have abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — Derwent abstract variants and Technology Focus
rubrics_metrics.description: Derwent offers Alerting, Documentation, Extended and original abstracts plus Abstract – Novelty and Abstract – Technology Focus fields that provide novelty statements and technology-specific viewpoints.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extension Abstract and Documentation give more detail than alerting abstracts; use these when deeper summary is required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — chemical indexing and fragment codes
rubrics_metrics.description: Chemical indexing fields include M0D..M6D (chemical fragment codes), DCR (Derwent Chemistry Resource number), DR (Derwent registry number), KWD (keyword indexing), plus Markush, specific/generic compound numbers and ring index numbers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Codes include Markush and DCR/registry numbers; chemical indexing available from certain DWPI update dates (see notes). Use provided examples for syntax (m2d(975061), dcr(975061)).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search fields — polymer indexing and PLASDOC
rubrics_metrics.description: Polymer indexing fields include PLASDOC/Polymer key serial (KS), Polymer fragment code (PF), Polymer indexing/DPI and related codes; polymer indexing present from specified DWPI updates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trailing punctuation in PLASDOC codes may have been replaced historically; consult notes for historical coding differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Search tools — where field codes may be used
rubrics_metrics.description: Field codes may be used in searches entered on Basic Search, Advanced Search, Command Line and Look Up Patent search pages.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use Look Up Patent to enter known patent details (number, title, assignee, inventor, dates) to locate a patent quickly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Limit options and date limiters
rubrics_metrics.description: Limit options on Advanced Search provide quick checkboxes for common concepts (Abstract included, Images included) and short lists for Patent publication country, Language and dates.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Date limiters support single dates or ranges for publication date, priority date, application date, and update date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Look up lists for browsing field contents
rubrics_metrics.description: Advanced Search offers Look up lists to browse contents of certain fields (Inventor, Patent assignee, Publication kind code, Classifications), useful to validate spellings or presence of specific data.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Terms found when browsing can be selected and automatically added to Advanced Search boxes; individual look up lists for Inventor, Patent assignee and Classification (IPC) are available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sorting and narrowing search results
rubrics_metrics.description: Search results can be sorted by Relevance, Publication date (oldest first) and Publication date (most recent first). The UI provides 'Narrow results by' filters (Inventor, Patent assignee, assignee country, publication country, publication kind code, classifications, database, publication date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clicking a filter shows ranked lists of most frequent terms; click a term to apply it and narrow results.

rubrics_metrics.name: Query syntax and operators
rubrics_metrics.description: Use adjacency and/or Boolean operators to narrow search results; right and left truncation is available.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples demonstrate combining field codes and operators; use AND IMGANY(YES) to restrict to records with images, use ABANY(YES) to restrict to records with abstracts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Result/document formats and what they contain
rubrics_metrics.description: Pre-defined formats (Brief/Detailed, KWIC, Preview, Citation/Abstract, Online Export/Download, Custom) control what fields are shown; each DWPI document includes patent family data and as-published member data depending on format.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Brief citation shows Derwent title and basic metadata; Detailed and Complete include bibliographic info, Derwent abstracts, Derwent indexing, patent family table, and where available original publication bibliographic info, abstracts and claims. Online view may contain truncated titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Export and custom download options
rubrics_metrics.description: Results can be downloaded via Download all results, Email, Print and Export/Save with formats PDF, RTF, XLS (custom only) and XML. Custom format lets you choose specific fields for export.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: XLS output is only available with a custom format. To design custom outputs, choose 'Custom' and check fields to be downloaded.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes on historical and missing data
rubrics_metrics.description: Some records (particularly pre-1970 or certain countries) may lack abstracts, some patent dates may be missing for records prior to 1974, and language coding changed historically.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IPC/CPC version differences, historical field length limits (e.g., author last name limited to 10 characters before a certain update) and other historical coding notes are provided; users should consult update notes when searching older records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to find source and coverage details
rubrics_metrics.description: Comprehensive details of the 50+ worldwide sources used to create DWPI can be downloaded from the DWPI coverage reference center URL.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Consult the Sources page to understand which patent authorities and publication kinds are included and how original publication data coverage varies by authority and time.
